# Build Workflow Agent
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Configure the workflow-wide agent behavior after routing exists and before quality is attached.

## Interface

```text
Workflow definition + stage registry + router -> workflow behavior -> AGENTS.md
```

| Input | Scope | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `<destination>/_config/workflow.md` | Full file | Outcome, users, constraints, and systems of record |
| `<destination>/_config/stage-registry.md` | Full file | Available roles and assembly state |
| `<destination>/CONTEXT.md` | Full file | Supported intents and loading order |
| `<destination>/setup/initialization-record.md` | Full file | Decisions, open questions, and setup status |
| `../../AGENTS.md` | Full file | Repository identity and output rules |
| `../../_config/conventions.md` | Context And Sources; Stage And Routing Contracts | Workflow behavior boundaries |

**Input gate:** Stop if the router or stage registry is missing, an assembly decision is unresolved, or the destination is not confirmed. Do not overwrite existing workflow behavior without permission.

**One transformation:** Configure workflow-wide behavior, setup checks, stage selection, run-control expectations, and user-facing response rules in `AGENTS.md`. Keep routing in `CONTEXT.md`, quality details in `_config/quality-policy.md`, and stage work in stage contracts. Do not duplicate those rules.

| Output | Location | Format | Consumer |
|---|---|---|---|
| Workflow behavior | `<destination>/AGENTS.md` | Markdown | User and execution agent |
| Assembly decision | `<destination>/setup/initialization-record.md` | Markdown | Quality builder and validator |

**Verify:** The agent file contains workflow-wide behavior only, points to the configured stage registry and quality policy, checks setup before execution, and does not repeat route tables or full quality rules.
